discrepancy_resolution.forensic_finding: The summary statement '2 validation patches' was a conceptual/typographical error in the summary text. In the synthetic pilot fixtures evaluated by Phase 9, there were exactly 6 patches (SMP_0001 through SMP_0006) of dimension 128x128 = 16,384 pixels each. 6 x 16,384 = exactly 98,304 pixels. The author conflated the 2 validation inventories of the real dataset ('chimanimani' and 'newzealand') with the number of patches, or mistakenly assumed 2 patches of dimension 128x384. In reality, the real Sen12Landslides validation split contains exactly 853 patches across 2 inventories: chimanimani (345 patches) and newzealand (508 patches), corresponding to 13,975,552 total pixels.
